newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen president visits Iran on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen president visits Iran on Wednesday.

text.p: Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov will start a two-day official visit to Iran on Wednesday on an invitation from President Hashemi Rafsanjani, an official from Niyazov's press service told Reuters.
"In (the Irani capital) Tehran both presidents will discuss issues of bilateral cooperation and regional problems, in particular, the situation in Afghanistan and Tajikistan," he said.

Both countries have repeatedly expressed concern over continuing bloodshed in Afghanistan and instability in Tajikistan, whose government agreed with the Islamist opposition on a ceasefire after a four-year civil war last December.
Another key issue under discussion will be the transportation of Turkmen gas to Turkey across Iran.

"In contrast to the well-known project of construction of a large-scale pipeline Turkemenistan-Iran-Turkey, which was broadly discussed in 1994-1995, the new project aims to use the existing pipeline system of Iran," a Turkmen oil and gas official told the official Turkmen Press news agency.
The new route of Turkmen gas exports will run separately from the joint Turkmen-Irani Korpedzhe-Kurt-Kuyi pipeline which is currently being built.
The presidents will also raise the issue of building a railway mainline which will connect Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan and Iran.
